title: Team Terra — Accounting Practices Seed
scope: Ten selected practice-office cities in ten countries; unranked research seed, not a hiring recommendation or licensing register.

records.name: Niman + Associates, Inc
records.evidence: Official homepage identifies the practice and lists an El Segundo office; its service sections cover business management, income tax, estate and trust work, and a virtual family office.

records.name: MNP LLP
records.evidence: The Vancouver office page identifies MNP LLP and its Granville Street location, with accounting, tax, bookkeeping and advisory services.
records.qualification: One selected office of MNP LLP; not a separate firm record for each service line or MNP LTD insolvency business.

records.name: Salles Sainz Grant Thornton, S.C.
records.evidence: The local firm’s office page names Salles Sainz Grant Thornton SC and a Ciudad de México office in Coyoacán; its navigation identifies audit, tax and business advisory services.
records.qualification: This is the named Mexican practice, not the global Grant Thornton network. Office announcement dates to 2021 and remains the current published office page.

records.name: HaysMac LLP
records.evidence: Official contact page lists Queen Street Place, London, and identifies HaysMac LLP in its footer. Services include audit, business outsourcing and tax.
records.qualification: One selected London office; the firm also publishes a Cape Town office.

records.name: Keobiz
records.evidence: Official contact page identifies Paris and Rouen offices. Paris is the selected office; accounting, payroll and taxation appear in its service menu.
records.qualification: Published practice brand retained; legal entity identifiers were not independently resolved. Paris office selected, not a claim that this is the sole office.

records.name: Baker Tilly Tuffias
records.evidence: The firm homepage identifies Baker Tilly Tuffias and Edenvale. The South Africa network’s official contact page independently lists this member practice at Greenstone Hill Office Park, Edenvale.
records.qualification: Current firm name retained rather than former Tuffias Sandberg. Firm homepage was available in the official search index but direct web extraction returned 429; the regional official contact page was fully readable. Services are from the indexed firm page title, not a regulatory check.

records.name: KKCO East Africa LLP
records.evidence: Official indexed contact page names KKCO East Africa LLP and places its office at Hurlingham on Argwings Kodhek Road in Nairobi, Kenya.
records.qualification: The official page’s indexed text provides the identity, address and service-category title; direct web extraction returned no readable lines. Treat as a qualified extraction pending independent page review.

records.name: Bansal & Co LLP
records.evidence: Official contact page labels two New Delhi offices; Office-1 is in Maharani Bagh. Service navigation includes assurance, tax and accounting support.
records.qualification: One selected office city. Firm statements about professional registrations were not independently verified and are not copied as status fields.

records.name: Foo Kon Tan LLP
records.evidence: Official contact page lists One Raffles Place in Singapore and identifies Foo Kon Tan LLP. Service navigation includes assurance, tax compliance and financial reporting/accounting advisory.
records.qualification: Named member firm kept separate from HLB International, which the footer describes as a network.

records.name: William Buck — Sydney
records.evidence: Official Sydney office page lists Goulburn Street and describes its audit, business advisory, tax and corporate advisory work.
records.qualification: Office-level published practice identity retained. Legal entity behind the Sydney office has not been independently resolved; not a global network or all-office record.

registration_sources.name: California Board of Accountancy — License Lookup
registration_sources.scope: Separate search routes for California CPAs and accounting firms, with out-of-state routes. This is licensing evidence, not a directory of every person who does bookkeeping.
registration_sources.reuse_note: No lookup submitted; bulk reuse not assessed.

registration_sources.name: ICAEW — Find a Chartered Accountant
registration_sources.scope: Search distinguishes members and firms; location filters apply to firms. Scope is ICAEW, not every UK accountant or every professional body.
registration_sources.reuse_note: No member or firm query submitted; bulk reuse not assessed.

registration_sources.name: SAICA — Verify a Member
registration_sources.scope: Verifies membership using names or a membership number; membership is distinct from an audit-firm or statutory-auditor registration.
registration_sources.reuse_note: Source expressly limits use to membership verification and prohibits direct marketing/advertising use. Do not treat it as a bulk lead source. No query submitted.

registration_sources.name: ICAI — Trace a Member and List of Firms
registration_sources.scope: Member lookup needs a six-digit membership registration number. Separate List of Firms is a dated snapshot as of 1 April 2026.
registration_sources.reuse_note: Trace-a-member form asks for requester details, email verification and CAPTCHA. No form completed, no query submitted, no bulk reuse assessed.

registration_sources.name: CA ANZ — Find a CA
registration_sources.jurisdiction: Australia and New Zealand / CA ANZ
registration_sources.scope: Includes opted-in public-practice certificate holders, opted-in specialists, and New Zealand qualified auditors. The page explicitly says this is not an exhaustive member list.
registration_sources.reuse_note: No query submitted; membership verification and reuse conditions need separate review.

limitations: All coordinates intentionally null pending sourced city geocoding.
Practice branding and self-described services do not independently establish licensure, auditor status or individual credentials.
No personal contact details, home locations or individual registration records were collected.
No bulk directory import or unsolicited outreach was performed.
Baker Tilly Tuffias and KKCO include explicit extraction qualifications.
